item.text: I’m making one small improvement before I wrap up: observers that subscribe only to `PopulationChangedEvent` should still be able to initialize from the current simulation state when they attach, instead of waiting for a later change.

Refactored the observer layer from a single snapshot callback into a typed event system.

`SimulationObserver` now declares its subscriptions via `getSubscribedEventTypes()` and receives `SimulationEvent` instances through `onSimulationEvent(...)`, with built-in type filtering in [SimulationObserver.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/SimulationObserver.java:4). I added a small event hierarchy around the existing snapshot payload: [SimulationEvent.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/SimulationEvent.java:1), [AbstractSimulationEvent.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/AbstractSimulationEvent.java:1), [SimulationResetEvent.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/SimulationResetEvent.java:1), [SimulationStepCompletedEvent.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/SimulationStepCompletedEvent.java:1), and [PopulationChangedEvent.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/PopulationChangedEvent.java:6). `SimulationSnapshot` remains the shared state payload for event consumers.

`Simulator` now emits granular events instead of broadcasting every update to every observer. On reset it emits `SimulationResetEvent` and, when applicable, `PopulationChangedEvent`; on each step it emits `PopulationChangedEvent` only when the class-by-class population map changes, followed by `SimulationStepCompletedEvent`. That dispatch logic is in [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Simulator.java:129). I also added initial event dispatch on observer registration so even observers that subscribe only to `PopulationChangedEvent` can initialize from the current state.

The Swing views now subscribe selectively. [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/SimulatorView.java:60) listens only for reset and step-completed events, while [GraphView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/GraphView.java:44) subscribes to reset, step-completed, and population-changed events so it can react differently to structural population changes versus ordinary step progression.

Verified with `javac *.java`. I did not run the Swing UI interactively here.
